correctness.rationale: The pair parametrization exhausts all unordered pairs including antipodes. The explicit rank \(R=n(d-1)+j+1\) is non-increasing by at most one under every letter, and precisely one letter reduces it by one. The unique descent is exactly \(a^j b(a^{n-1}b)^{d-1}\), establishing all lengths and uniqueness in all \(n\ge3\). Reverse BFS independently checked 10,659 pairs for \(3\le n\le40\), all distance multiplicities, path counts, words, and edge inequalities; bounded checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete, natural infinite-family classification of shortest control words for every two-state subset of the classical extremal Černý automata. It gives a uniquely realized full pair-merging length spectrum, explicit optimal controls, symbol-composition enumerator, and sharp contrast between worst and mean minimum merging times. These are pair-compression invariants relevant to known synchronization methods; no general Černý conjecture breakthrough or arbitrary numerical slice is asserted.
